sources.title: 2025—2026年小麦（三等）最低收购价每50公斤119元
sources.interpretation: Fixed benchmark valuation, not automatic purchase-policy eligibility or the 2020 realized farm-gate price.
Urea is priced per kg product. Water includes pumping; drying is priced per kg actually processed.
Declared experimental seed/service quotes, not a verified 2025 wheat farm cost survey. Machinery services include fuel/operator; no extra fuel is charged.

accounting: Actual consumed seed and urea product, gross water purchased, field services, drying throughput and storage. No land rent, capital depreciation or ordinary labor beyond the quoted services.
